scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --workspace=host" "npm run start --workspace=remote1" "npm run start --workspace=remote2"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=remote1 && npm run build --workspace=remote2 && npm run build --workspace=host
scripts.build:netlify: cd remote1 && ../node_modules/.bin/webpack --config webpack.config.js --mode production && cd ../remote2 && ../node_modules/.bin/webpack --config webpack.config.js --mode production && cd ../host && ../node_modules/.bin/webpack --config webpack.config.js --mode production && cd .. && mkdir -p dist/remote1 dist/remote2 && cp -r remote1/dist/. dist/remote1/ && cp -r remote2/dist/. dist/remote2/ && cp -r host/dist/. dist/
